Préface p14.text: El cristianismo trae la poesía a la verdad. Como él, la musa moderna verá las cosas con una mirada más alta y más extensa. Ella sentirá que no todo en la creación es humanamente bello, que allí existe lo feo al lado de lo bello, lo deforme junto a lo gracioso, lo grotesco al revés de lo sublime, el mal con el bien, la sombra con la luz
Préface p14.quotation_pages: UBA proceedings p. 43 (PDF p. 51); 1979 edition cited p. 31

research_update: A separate research reader located the University of Chile article https://revistateoriadelarte.uchile.cl/index.php/RTA/article/download/39947/41516/138465, which cites Peirotti 1979 for four of five places: p14 split by commentary (1979 p.31), p14b (31–32), p16 (35), p23 (45–46); complete p24 not found. At p14b its criaturas may differ from French créations: only the book can settle whether this is a quotation or translation difference. It cannot prove sentence continuity or exact punctuation in the edition. A 2013 death for Hernán Peirotti is strongly indicated but the university obituary archive date is inconsistent; corroborate identity and date before recording as fact. A separate older translation by Jacinto Labaila (1833–1895) is catalogued, including the preface in a 1967 edition; an 1887 volume containing the play is a lead, but its preface and text are unverified. No scan of Peirotti or Labaila has been independently checked and no formal kit review has occurred.
